## European Cups

### Gladiators Trier Continue Dominant Form in FIBA Europe Cup

The Gladiators Trier have extended their impressive winning streak in the FIBA Europe Cup, securing their seventh consecutive victory. In their latest match, they faced Promitheas Patras, a strong opponent from the group stage, and dominated the game from the start. The Rheinland-Pfälzer team took control early on, establishing clear superiority. This win marks another successful outing for the Gladiators Trier, who are considered one of the top teams in the easyCredit BBL. With a strong start to the season, they are well on their way to becoming a top team in the league.

### Patricio Garino extends contract with Phoenix Hagen until 2027

Patricio Garino has extended his contract with Phoenix Hagen until the end of the 2026/2027 season. The Argentine player was initially set to leave the team in November, but has now committed to staying with the club. Garino has been a key contributor to Phoenix Hagen, averaging 6.1 points and 3.3 rebounds in ten league games. He also played a crucial role in the team's Netto BBL Pokal victory over Ulm, scoring 17 points and providing four assists. Phoenix Hagen head coach Chris Harris praised Garino's international experience and calm demeanor, saying that his presence will be essential in the team's bid to avoid relegation. Garino expressed his happiness at staying with the team, citing the strong chemistry within the squad and the special bond between the players and fans.

Sources:

- [Phoenix Hagen: Patricio Garino bleibt ein „Feuervogel“](https://www.phoenix-hagen.de/patricio-garino-bleibt-ein-feuervogel)

### Gladiators Trier Continue Strong Start in BBL

The Gladiators Trier are off to a strong start in the BBL, with seven wins in their first nine games, matching their performance from last season. They are currently second in the table, just behind Bayern. Trier's coach, Jacques Schneider, had warned against expecting a repeat of their impressive start last season, but he has been proven wrong. The team is also performing well in the FIBA Europe Cup, with seven wins in seven games, and have all but secured a spot in the second round. Eli Brooks, a returning player, is leading the offense for Trier. Despite a recent loss at home to Chemnitz, the team's strong start suggests they may be a top team in the BBL this season.

### Gladiators Trier Partner School for Basketball and Movement Week

The Vet-Concept Gladiators Trier partnered with a local school to participate in the Basketball-Grundschulwoche, a project supported by the DBB-Gesundheitspartner vivida bkk and the FIBA Europe Youth Development Fund. The goal of the project is to introduce basketball to elementary school students across Germany, provide a positive sports experience, and equip active schools with mini basketballs. The school received an action package with balls and materials in advance, and the Gladiators Trier worked with the school to enable all classes to participate. On November 18, 2026, Klaus Körmös, the school sports coordinator and mini-trainer for the Gladiators Trier, visited the school with a sack of basketballs and led the students through various exercises and games, including 'Schnick-Schnack-Schnuck', which involved dribbling and scoring points. The students participated in five areas: coordination, basic techniques, team play, basketball in school, and health, and received certificates and stickers at the end of the session.

### Bamberg Baskets Players on International Duty

Bamberg Baskets players Yuval Hochstadter and Richard Balint are on international duty with their respective national teams. Hochstadter, 26, will make his debut for Israel in the World Cup qualifiers against the Netherlands on Friday at 20:00 in Den Haag. Israel can still win the last spot in the group, but the top three spots are already taken. On Monday, Israel will face Latvia in Riga at 18:30. Meanwhile, Balint's Czech team is in the pre-qualifiers for the EuroBasket 2029 and will play against Belgium on Sunday in Prague at 17:45. The Czech team is led by coach Jesús Ramírez's former player, Tomas Satoransky, who will play his last game for the national team.

### Mushidi Withdraws from National Team, Jovanovic Heads to Serbia

Syntainics MBC player Kostja Mushidi has withdrawn from the German national team due to the impending birth of his first child. In a related move, the team's head coach Vladimir Jovanovic has been given permission to join the Serbian national team for the upcoming World Cup qualifying matches. Jovanovic will serve as an assistant coach to national team coach Dusan Alimpijevic, alongside Milenko Bogicevic and Jovan Novak, a former player of the German team Würzburg. The Serbian team is currently second in Group J with 6 wins and 2 losses, behind only Turkey. Jovanovic will miss the Syntainics MBC's games while he is away with the Serbian team, which will play in Lithuania and host Italy in the coming days.

### Vechta's U19 Team Wins Third Game in Qualification Round

Rasta Vechta's under-19 team continued their strong performance in the Nachwuchs Basketball Bundesliga, winning their third game in the 1st round of the qualification round. On Sunday, they defeated Team Bonn/Rhöndorf 82-74 (41-38). Seven Rasta players scored 8 or more points, with Moritz Grüß leading the list with 16 points. Assistant coach Lennart Stechmann took charge of the team due to Hendrik Gruhn's absence, and praised the team's energy in the first and third quarters. However, he noted that the team struggled in the second and fourth quarters. Malik Idbihi was the top scorer for the visitors with 17 points.

### Hamburg Towers' WNBL Secures Top Spot with Convincing Win

The Hamburg Towers' WNBL team secured a convincing 75:36 win over Capitol Bascats Düsseldorf, completing a successful first season phase. The team, led by Head Coach Laura Zdravevska, dominated the game from the start, forcing 26 turnovers and controlling the pace. Despite some initial ball losses, the Towers found their rhythm in the second quarter and used their turnovers to create quick scoring opportunities. The win secured the team's qualification for the main round and sets the stage for a potential playoff run. Meanwhile, the JBBL team lost 55:75 to ALBA BERLIN, with the second half proving decisive. The team's focus now shifts to the main round, which begins in two weeks.
